column3: NASB renders “servants” as “bond-servants” and adds “including.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
Close to the Greek.
NASB renders “upon every remembrance” as “in all my remembrance.”
NASB reorders the verse; “supplication” is rendered “prayer.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “in view of” and renders “partnership” as “participation.”
NASB renders “having been persuaded” as “I am confident” and “complete” as “perfect.”
NASB renders “chains” as “imprisonment” and restructures the verse.
NASB follows the critical text; “in the affection” is rendered “with the affection.”
NASB renders “knowledge” as “real knowledge.”
NASB renders “pure” as “sincere.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “comes.”
NASB renders “the things concerning me” as “my circumstances” and “advancement” as “greater progress.”
NASB renders “chains” as “imprisonment,” “in Christ” as “in the cause of Christ,” and “palace guard” as “praetorian guard.”
NASB has “the word of God,” following manuscripts with “of God”; “chains” is rendered “imprisonment.”
NASB adds “to be sure.”
NASB follows the critical text's order, in which this verse speaks of those who preach out of love; it adds “the latter do it.”
NASB follows the critical text's order; it adds “the former” and renders “to add tribulation to my chains” as “to cause me distress in my imprisonment.”
NASB follows the critical text (“that”); “pretext” is rendered “pretense.”
NASB renders “prayer” as “prayers.”
NASB renders “be ashamed” as “be put to shame” and “be magnified” as “be exalted.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB adds “on” and renders “fruit of labor” as “fruitful labor.”
NASB follows the critical text; “pressed between the two” is rendered “hard-pressed from both directions.”
NASB adds “on.”
NASB follows the critical text; “having been persuaded” is rendered “convinced.”
NASB renders “boasting” as “proud confidence” and reorders the verse.
NASB follows the critical text (“I may hear”); “worthily” is rendered “in a manner worthy.”
NASB follows the critical text (“for you”); “demonstration” is rendered “sign,” and the clause is set off with a dash.
NASB renders “on behalf of Christ” as “for Christ's sake.”
NASB follows the critical text (“you saw”); “having” is rendered “experiencing.”
